as_told.title: STS-48 and STS-80 space shuttle cases

plain: Two space shuttle missions, STS-48 in 1991 and STS-80 in 1996, are said to have filmed unexplained objects in Earth orbit, what are now called UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena. A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani points to these two videos on the show, without naming a source, as among the stronger cases from space, and later refers back to them in passing. If they show what he suggests, NASA would have recorded unexplained objects on its own missions.
